id./param/scenario/cs/a_180_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Ugh... That black aura... We can't land a blow...
"Such unnatural power... Could it be... Could it be you...!?
"So this is the Heart of Yggdrasil. With this, I can do as I please with the world...
"Sire, did you see that fight? Jasper's power is the power of darkness...
"We have been badly mistaken for a long time. Jasper is the one who brings ruin to this land!
"Jasper! Why did you give your soul to darkness!?
"I'll hear no excuses! Jasper, you die before your king!
"Sire... What is the meaning of this?
"And Jasper. Well done in cutting down the Luminary. I commend you.
"You're Mordegon! He possessed the King all along!
"Luminary. Now you fall into my grasp... I shall take your power."
